text:
alice.h: Kicking off the asia-north2 GPU account + VNet wire-up. Need quick consensus on CIDR ranges, NAT pattern, and quota timeline.
ben: Quick note — cloud quotas: requested 40 A100 GPUs in ticket #12345, support replied ETA 36h. We should plan a soft launch with 8 nodes first. :thumbsup:
dan: For CIDR I propose using 10.64.0.0/18 for primary VPC and 10.65.0.0/20 for shared-services (logging, metrics, bastion). Keeps things small and avoids collisions with EU ranges.
carla: Agree on the split. Call out these subnets: public-egress: 10.64.0.0/22, private-workers: 10.64.4.0/22, private-cache: 10.64.8.0/23, shared-services: 10.65.0.0/20. We can expand within the /18 later.
emily: Regarding egress pattern — we should use a centralized NAT in the shared-services AZ (t2.small NAT instance or managed NAT gateway?). Managed NAT will cost more but avoids single-host flakiness for rollout. Cost tradeoff call?
ben: For initial week use managed NAT gateway to avoid incidents, then evaluate moving to NAT HA instances if cost spikes. Put it on the budget tracker.
alice.h: Security & connectivity: need S3 VPC endpoints, KMS access from workers, and Transit Gateway peer to prod-transit in us-east-1 for replication. Is there any policy blocking TG attachments cross-region?
emily: TG cross-region attachments are supported but costs are non-trivial (per-GB). Also need to enable route propagation on the attachment route tables. We should document expected egress cost for model pulls (~5TB/month estimate).
carla: On KMS: create a customer-managed CMK in asia-north2 with key policy: allow account root + the redwood-service role; provide terraform snippet in the infra module.
carla: ```hcl
resource "aws_kms_key" "redwood_data" {
  description = "Redwood encryption key for asia-north2"
  policy      = file("kms-policy-asia-north2.json")
}
```
dan: Terraform & modules: please use the new tf-mod-networking v2 which includes AZ aware subnets + tags. Reminder: set enable_flow_logs = true and log_group = "/infra/vpc/asia-north2".
alice.h: Validation checklist before handoff to platform team: 1) VPC CIDR & subnets created 2) route tables + IGW + NAT 3) S3 endpoint & KMS 4) Security groups for worker -> model-registry 5) TG peer established + route propagation 6) GPU quota ticket resolved 7) Cost estimate in shared doc 8) smoke cluster deployed with 1 GPU node and perf tests. Anyone add items?
ben: Add: ensure IAM role for node bootstrap has kms:Decrypt and s3:GetObject for startup configs.
emily: Add firewall egress rules: block 0.0.0.0/0 from private-cache, allow to package mirrors & redwood-updates only.
carla: I'll spin up the TF plan and push to infra-repo branch asia-north2/vpc. Expect PR by EOD.
alice.h: Great — when PR is up, ping this thread. Also tagging infra-bot to capture cost estimate snapshot.
infra-bot: cost-snapshot: estimated monthly baseline for asia-north2 with managed NAT + 8 A100s (reserved): $48,200. Inter-region transfer (us-east-1 replication) est: $2,300/mo.
ben: Thanks infra-bot. If quota arrives earlier we can scale to 16 nodes after smoke validates.
alice.h: Hand-off plan: Carla -> create PR + run tf apply in staging; Ben -> provision 1 GPU smoke node and run perf: ./scripts/smoke-run.sh --cpus 4 --gpus 1 --seq 1024; Dan -> add flow logs & CloudWatch dashboards; Emily -> open TG attach and confirm egress pricing with finance.
carla: On it. Will include a small README in the infra module with runbook steps and rollback notes.
dan: I'll set up the dashboard template and paste links here once ready.
ben: One more ask — add a node pool label: "region=asia-north2,env=staging" so our autoscaler picks correct machines.
alice.h: Perfect. Thanks team. Follow-ups in thread. :rocket:
